datasets.title: Central Asia Exposure - Multi-Sector Database (SFRARR)
datasets.description: Regionally consistent, multi-sector exposure database for Central Asia (Kazakhstan, Kyrgyz Republic, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan) developed under the SFRARR program. Covers population, residential and non-residential buildings, croplands, the transport system, airports and supply infrastructure for multi-country, multi-hazard risk assessment at regional, national and sub-national (oblast) scale.
datasets.purpose: Regional risk modelling. These data have been derived on a regional scale for the purpose of consistent regional multi-country hazard and risk assessment. Application of this information on smaller scales should be done with care. project.name: SFRARR - Strengthening Financial Resilience and Accelerating Risk Reduction in Central Asia

datasets.details: Data from the EU-funded 'Strengthening Financial Resilience and Accelerating Risk Reduction in Central Asia' Program (https://www.gfdrr.org/en/program/SFRARR-Central-Asia). Exposure data developed using high-resolution global and regional datasets and local official data, harmonized to produce a regionally-consistent exposure database for Central Asia. The exposure database includes: population, residential buildings, non-residential buildings (schools, healthcare facilities, industrial and commercial buildings), croplands, transportation system (roads, railways and bridges), airports and airstrips, mines, and supply infrastructure. The exposure database developed during this project can be used at regional scale, national scale or sub-national scale (e.g., at Oblast scale).
